text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, is that today? Thanks for the
reminder. I
needed to make updates to
all of my data.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How could you forget your
birthday?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, age itself can be important for
research, but
what I find most intriguing
is recording the effects
of time on the
body, and—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a sec... Is no one celebrating
your
birthday with you?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? No, not really... I do receive gifts,
but such
things are nonnecessities—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a party for you! I'll go
get
everyone together right now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, listen to me. Though it'd be
beneficial for
my test subjects to gather
in one place, their
attention on me
would make observing rather
diffi—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
We'll get all sorts of food too. Oh, and
I've
already got your present. I bet
you're going to
love it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
This'll be great, Tachyon. You're going
to get a
party you'll remember for the
rest of your life!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I'm always perplexed by that force of
will and
inability to listen of yours.
Perhaps it's some
hereditary trait from
your parents?
